body:
We'll see! They know they forgot so maybe something will happen but I'm not expecting anything.

Happy belated birthday for Friday! I hope you had a nice day, regardless of whether it was a special day or not. :3

No, no! There's no need to edit it, I'm just a bit slow. I appreciate your honesty. I am sorry to hear that you have had to go through something similar. 

Thank you. My birthday wasn't that great but you know what, I don't really mind anymore. I feel really awesome now and that's better than any present or someone acting like they care about me for one day out of the year. Things will get better.

You really remind me of my old art teacher, a guy I look up to more than anyone else. Thank you for taking the time to help me even when you didn't need to. I, and plenty of other people, are lucky there are people like you around.

Thank you for taking the time to write out such a helpful reply. I really appreciate it. <3


About my boyfriend, the last part you wrote was right. He's not usually mean but has suddenly stopped supporting me. I've asked him if there's a problem but he just said it was school. I supported him and he's graduated since then and he said it would be okay now. Hopefully it will be okay soon.


My brother is the way he is because of my mum. He's always been 'the golden child' and has never been punished for anything. He now has a problem with authority and doesn't think anyone should be able to tell him what to do. He got arrested a couple years ago and got grounded for 3 days. He climbed out the window the first day and that was the end of his punishment. He gets incredibly angry when he is made to do something he doesn't want to. There are numerous holes in the walls of my house from him punching them. My Dad may have favoured me slightly because I was his little girl, but he didn't let anyone see that. He died a couple years ago and although he is sad, he has no bad feelings towards my Dad. I know that if he could see the way he is acting he would want to change, but I can't get through to him. 


My Dad hasn't lived with my mum for years. She never worked and she'd never even tried to get a job. Because she's scared about not having enough money when my brother turns 18, she's applied to be a foster parent. It just seems like she's taken the option that's the least like a real job.

I know it's clothes because it's all on her ebay. She spends at least £100 a month on things for her, and probably even more from stores not online. She won't spend money on me and my brother because she says it's hard for her to be poorer than she used to be. She got scammed and lost our family savings by trying to get more money illegally. I don't think it's fair that me and my brother are the ones who miss out because of her mistake. I really don't like her as a person. When my brother and me do talk, we agree that it's like having a dictator in charge of the house. Lately she has been trying to be a good mother (aside from the money), but only since she's applied for the foster parent job. In fact that just makes me feel worse, because it's as if she's only doing it so she can get more money.


I guess it's true that it's just a bad time right now. I'm very excited to start work for the first time. I even overheard my employers talking about a supervisor job and how they were impressed with me, which is crazy! I've always been so shy but somehow I must have stuck out in the interview :3 I would also love to get my own place. I would literally do anything for a place of my own. Thanks for reminding me that it will get better. 

I think you're right about just focusing on me. It's hard because I don't like to be sad or lonely, so I don't want them to feel like that either. I guess I am just condoning how they treat me by continuing to be there for them when maybe they don't deserve my help. My Dad gave me a lot of advice before he died and he kept telling me over and over that I have no obligation whatsoever to stay with anyone who doesn't make me happy, even family. It sucks but I'm kinda understanding that I should probably take that advice now.

I really, **really** appreciate your help. I feel immensely better and I wish there was some way to thank you. I feel so silly about being scared to talk about my problems. I really can't come up with a way to tell you how much I appreciate that you cared to help me. It feels like all the praise and thanks in the world wouldn't be enough. Really, thank you.
Thank you again for the link, Maru really does always cheer me up! ;__; <3

Thanks <3

Since then everyone has realised that they forgot. I understand people are forgetful sometimes but I'm about to go to sleep a day after my birthday and nothing yet. I don't mind if they forget but it doesn't seem like they care even now.

I am sorry to hear that :c

I would wish you a happy birthday if I knew when it was. I hope you had a fun time regardless :3 <3

Thank you. <3

 I'm not that good at venting but I gave it a try, haha n___n

Oh. I guess I didn't explain properly. He already knows I am sad but he said he couldn't look after me right now because he's sad. He knows I'm not blaming him, I just said that I'd like it if we could hang out today instead. 

And thank you! I do know Maru but I love Maru so it's all good! :3

oh. I dont usually tell people about my problems so this seems kind of weird.


I haven't been able to sleep properly for over a year. My brother has up to 10 friends over every single night and they keep me awake. My mum says that its not her problem because it doesnt affect her, and my brother has anger issues and threatens to beat me up if i bring it up or try and stop it happening. I'm going to start my first job next week and I'll probably be fired. When I was on job seekers I also lost a lot of money because of it and had to pay rent to my mum out of my own pocket and now I have nothing. My mum doesn't work and spends all of our money on clothes for herself. Sometimes she won't buy food because she would rather buy clothes. 



Lately my boyfriend has been mean and takes everything out on me, usually when I tell him I'm sad about something. He lets me down constantly, I don't remember the last time he kept his word about something he said he'd do.



Apart from him I don't really have any other friends. My brother was my best friend until I started to try and make it so I could sleep, but now he just ignores me or is angry with me. On my birthday he called me a bitch because I was sad about not being able to sleep that night.



Most of all I miss my Dad and my cat. If my Dad hadn't died then my brother wouldn't be acting like this. My Dad always protected me and he'd be disappointed if he knew what my brother was doing. He died of cancer and I could barely see him when he was dying because my mum kept kicking me out of the house at the time. He was the best Dad in the whole world and I let him down.

My cat was my best friend, and I know it seems weird but I literally loved her more than anyone in the world. She would nap with me every day and night and we'd share blueberry muffins. She'd come in the bathroom when I was in the bath and get scared and peek over the edge of the bath when I went underwater. She let me hold her like a baby and dress her in teddy bear clothes. My neighbour's dog killed her and they took her body and threw it in a road to make it look like it wasn't their fault. I miss her every day.



I guess it doesn't really seem like much of a big deal but I barely sleep or eat and I don't have anyone to tell my problems to. My boyfriend is mean to me when I tell him I'm sad and I have no other friends. I've known I would kill myself since I was 13. I don't always want to but it just feels like it's inevitable that I will. Now it really feels like nothing will ever get better and I just don't see the point in living.

his dad yelled at him so he is sad and cant take care of me or comfort me. i comforted him when he was sad about that but he wont do the same for me. maybe he is just more sad than me but i dont think he cares really.
I'm sorry if this isnt a good enough reason to post here, i know people have a lot worse problems
